tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Excalidraw API key and connectivity.

tools.name: list-scenes
tools.description: List all Excalidraw scenes in the workspace with their metadata and links. Supports pagination via cursor.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to get the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of scenes to return per page (default: 50).

tools.name: get-scene
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific Excalidraw scene by its ID, including links and sharing settings.

tools.name: get-scene-content
tools.description: Retrieve the complete drawing content of an Excalidraw scene: all elements (shapes, text, arrows, etc.), app state, and embedded files.

sceneId.description: The scene ID whose content to retrieve.

tools.name: create-scene
tools.description: Create a new empty Excalidraw scene with specified metadata. Optionally assign it to a collection and pin it. Returns the created scene with its ID and sharing links.

collectionId.description: ID of the collection to place the scene in.

pinned.description: Whether to pin the scene (default: false).

tools.name: update-scene
tools.description: Update the metadata of an existing Excalidraw scene (name, pinned status, collection assignment).

collectionId.description: Move the scene to a different collection by providing its ID.

tools.name: update-scene-content
tools.description: Replace the complete drawing content of an Excalidraw scene with new elements. WARNING: this is a full replace — existing content is overwritten. Pass the full array of elements you want the scene to contain.

elements.description: Array of Excalidraw element objects (shapes, text, arrows, etc.). This replaces all existing elements.

appState.description: Optional Excalidraw app state (viewport, theme, etc.).

files.description: Optional embedded files map (e.g. images referenced in the scene).

tools.name: delete-scene
tools.description: Soft-delete an Excalidraw scene by moving it to trash. The scene can be recovered from the Excalidraw Plus UI.

tools.name: list-collections
tools.description: List all collections in the Excalidraw Plus workspace. Collections are folders that group related scenes together.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return (default: 50).

tools.name: get-collection
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Excalidraw collection by its ID.

tools.name: get-collection-scenes
tools.description: List all scenes that belong to a specific Excalidraw collection.

collectionId.description: The collection ID to list scenes from.

tools.name: create-collection
tools.description: Create a new collection (folder) in the Excalidraw Plus workspace to group related scenes.

tools.name: create-collection-scene
tools.description: Create a new scene directly inside a specific Excalidraw collection.

collectionId.description: The collection ID to create the scene in.

pinned.description: Whether to pin the scene (default: false).

tools.name: update-collection
tools.description: Update the metadata of an existing Excalidraw collection (e.g. rename it).

tools.name: delete-collection
tools.description: Soft-delete an Excalidraw collection by moving it to trash. Scenes inside are not deleted.

tools.name: get-workspace
tools.description: Retrieve the current Excalidraw Plus workspace's metadata, including name, users, and invites.

tools.name: update-workspace
tools.description: Update the current Excalidraw Plus workspace's metadata (e.g. rename it).

tools.name: list-users
tools.description: List all users in the Excalidraw Plus workspace with their roles and metadata.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return (default: 50).

tools.name: get-user
tools.description: Get details for a specific user in the Excalidraw Plus workspace by their user ID.

tools.name: update-user
tools.description: Update a workspace user in Excalidraw Plus (e.g. change their role or name).

name.description: New display name for the user.

tools.name: remove-user
tools.description: Remove a user from the Excalidraw Plus workspace, revoking their access.

userId.description: The user ID to remove from the workspace.

tools.name: list-invites
tools.description: List all pending and active invites for the Excalidraw Plus workspace.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of invites to return (default: 50).

tools.name: create-invite
tools.description: Invite a user to the Excalidraw Plus workspace by email. Optionally specify their role.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite.

role.description: Role to assign (e.g. "admin", "member"). Defaults to workspace default.

tools.name: get-invite
tools.description: Get details for a specific Excalidraw Plus workspace invite by its ID.

tools.name: update-invite
tools.description: Update an existing Excalidraw Plus workspace invite (e.g. change the assigned role).

role.description: New role to assign to the invitee.

tools.name: delete-invite
tools.description: Delete a pending Excalidraw Plus workspace invite, revoking the invitation.

tools.name: list-logs
tools.description: Retrieve workspace audit logs from Excalidraw Plus. Useful for tracking activity, changes, and access history.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (default: 50).
